### Connection

| Command | Usage | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `login` | `motherbase login [--url <consoleUrl>] [--email <email>] [--code <totp>]` | Log in to a Motherbase Console (email/password → session token) |
| `logout` | `motherbase logout [--url <consoleUrl>]` | Remove the stored token for the current (or --url) console |
| `whoami` | `motherbase whoami` | Show the current console, account and platform info |
| `link` | `motherbase link [projectNameOrId]` | Link the current directory to a project (writes ./.motherbase/config.json) |
| `unlink` | `motherbase unlink` | Remove the project link from the current directory |
| `status` | `motherbase status` | Show connection status: console, link, and a project health probe |

| `projects rebuild` | `motherbase projects rebuild <id>` | rebuild a project |

| `branches list` | `motherbase branches list` | List the branches of the linked project, main first |
| `branches get` | `motherbase branches get <name>` | Show one branch, with the migrations it is ahead and behind |

| `branches reset` | `motherbase branches reset <name>` | Recreate a branch from the parent as it is now (its changes are lost) |

| `branches rebase` | `motherbase branches rebase <name>` | Apply the parent's newer migrations to the branch |

| `domains delete` | `motherbase domains delete` | Stop using the custom hostname |

| `vanity-subdomains activate` | `motherbase vanity-subdomains activate --desired-subdomain <name>` | Serve the API on <name>.<platform domain> as well |
| `vanity-subdomains delete` | `motherbase vanity-subdomains delete` | Remove the vanity subdomain |

| `gen` | `motherbase gen <types\|signing-key\|bearer-jwt\|keys> ...` | Generate code from the live schema, and signing keys, tokens and secrets |
